clauses.name: Disfigure
clauses.printedParagraph: Destroy a target manifestation, on the field or in an Empathic Vessel, that has 20 or less points of value.

clauses.name: Knobbly Colossus
clauses.printedParagraph: If Knobbly Colossus wins the confrontation, you can destroy a target Will or manifestation on the field controlled by an opponent.

clauses.name: Borombo, the Mad
clauses.printedParagraph: If Borombo loses the confrontation, destroy a target manifestation in the Confrontation Zone controlled by an opponent.

clauses.name: Deviate
clauses.printedParagraph: Lose 5 points. You can play this Will only during the Resolution.

clauses.name: Deviate
clauses.printedParagraph: Destroy a target manifestation in the Confrontation Zone that lost the confrontation this turn.

clauses.name: Repress the Self
clauses.printedParagraph: You can play this Will only during the Resolution.

clauses.name: Repress the Self
clauses.printedParagraph: Destroy a target manifestation in the Confrontation Zone under your control that won the confrontation this turn, then gain its points.

clauses.name: Convert the Pain
clauses.printedParagraph: Destroy up to 2 target Manifestations in Support. Each player draws 2 cards for each Manifestation they control destroyed this way.

clauses.name: Multicastigate
clauses.printedParagraph: You may pay 3 extra 🔘 essences to play this Will.

clauses.name: Multicastigate
clauses.printedParagraph: Destroy a target Manifestation in Support.

clauses.name: Multicastigate
clauses.printedParagraph: If you paid the extra essences, Destroy 2 target Manifestations in Support instead.

clauses.name: Lilitha, the Dismemberer
clauses.printedParagraph: When Lilitha enters the Confrontation Zone, you may Destroy a target manifestation in the Confrontation Zone. If you do, that manifestation’s controller puts a number of Tokens with 1 🔘 power equal to its base power in Support under their control.
